pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū anācāraṃ ācaritvā ekamekassa kamme kayiramāne paṭikkosanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.3: tena kho pana samayena saṅgho sannipatito hoti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.4: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū cīvarakammaṃ karontā ekassa chandaṃ adaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.6: ayaṃ āvuso chabbaggiyo bhikkhu ekako āgato handassa mayaṃ kammaṃ karomāti tassa kammaṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.7: athakho so bhikkhu yena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.11: na mayaṃ āvuso etadatthāya chandaṃ adamhā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.13: sace mayaṃ jāneyyāma tuyhaṃ kammaṃ karissatīti na mayaṃ chandaṃ dadeyyāmāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.14: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.15: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.16: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjathāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.19: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjissatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.20: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.21: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.22.1: yo pana bhikkhu dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:2.1.6: apalokanakammaṃ ñattikammaṃ ñattidutiyakammaṃ ñatticatutthakammaṃ dhammena vinayena satthu sāsanena kataṃ etaṃ dhammikaṃ nāma kammaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:2.2.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī chandaṃ datvā khīyati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:2.2.2: dhammakamme vematiko chandaṃ datvā khīyati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:2.2.3: dhammakamme adhammakammasaññī chandaṃ datvā khīyati anāpatti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:2.3.2: adhammena vā vaggena vā na kammārahassa vā kammaṃ katanti jānanto khīyati
